exact_statement: For every Boolean sign function under an interior product law, its natural corrected singleton entropy obeys E_single<=4delta-2R, where delta=I-Var and R=sum_{|S|>=3}(|S|-2)P(S). For every essential ternary prime the corrected entropy in bits satisfies Hplus<Cstar*delta in the interior, and each of the five ternary prime symmetry orbits has supremum Hplus/delta=Cstar=2+4/ln(2). Together with the exact binary bound and disjoint composition, Hplus<=Cstar*delta holds for every Boolean gate on at most three essential inputs and every genuine read-once formula of such gates under arbitrary interior physical product laws, with contraction for deterministic inputs; this implies ordinary uniform-input H<=Cstar*I. The proposed all-arity prime companion E_ge2<=ln(4)*delta+2R is false: the essential four-input prime positive exactly at binary-index assignments 7,8,15 (mask 33152), at probabilities (1/2,1/2,1/2,1/1024), has companion excess >13/100, while (4+ln(4))*delta-E_total>9/20 at that same law. Full FEI and the all-arity biased-prime constant remain open.
hypotheses: Boolean signs on finite cubes, independent Bernoulli coordinates, normalized product Fourier basis
spectral influence I=sum |S|P(S), Var=sum_{S nonempty}P(S), corrected Hplus=sum_{S nonempty}P(S)log2(v_S/P(S))
natural-unit E=(ln2)Hplus; zero terms interpreted continuously; v_i=4p_i(1-p_i)
prime means essential with no proper block of size 2..n-1 having exactly two cofactor rows; constants and literals terminal
no variable reuse in the formula conclusion; deterministic children contracted before normalization
all input biases interior for strict ternary inequality and explicit prime obstruction; sharpness is a supremum of interior ratios, not a boundary ratio at zero deficit
the signed reserve is all-dimensional, the sharp prime bound is restricted to arity three, and no all-dimensional FEI conclusion is asserted
contributors: A043/fleet05 (three new orbit bounds, signed reserve, prime obstruction, package)
